hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; root=$(cd "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); py="$root/.venv/bin/python"; [ -x "$py" ] || exit 0; out=$("$py" -m pyflakes "$f" 2>&1) || jq -n --arg o "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse",additionalContext:("pyflakes on the file just edited:\n" + $o + "\nAn undefined name here usually means an edit landed in the wrong function. Fix before continuing.")}}'
